limits: Independent numeric/clock/current-byte consistency only; actual per-arm native/privacy/visual checks remain the original separately bound four reviews.
Snapshot empirical distributions are correlated; pooled nearest-rank percentiles are not equal-time means or independent repetitions.
Duration-weighted disjoint counter-read intervals only; neither full-window CPU nor a common-time family bound, tick-quantization bound or statistical confidence interval.
Thread/context/wakeup probes were not collected; removing them changes observer cost. No v1 sample or failed v1 A1 contributes to these four v2 arms.
Whole-host quiet, Windows names, GPU, first-interactive/search-ready/IME/DPI/multimonitor and performance adoption remain unverified.
